title: Pro-etale descent for continuous set functions
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $D$ any topological space, with $X$ in universe $u$ and $D$ in universe $u+1$ [def-weil-size-convention]. The presheaf $U\mapsto C(|U|,D)$ on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], with restriction by precomposition [def-sfb-continuous-set-presheaf], is a sheaf. No separation, disconnectedness or nonemptiness hypothesis is required.

source.place: Lemma 4.2.12, first assertion, p. 30; restriction of the fpqc continuous-map sheaf to the small pro-etale site.

proof.text: Mathlib proves fpqc descent for the actual continuous-map presheaf by quotient-map descent. The pro-etale topology is contained in the fpqc topology, so this presheaf is a sheaf for the big pro-etale topology. Restrict along the continuous forgetful functor from the small site to schemes; its presheaf is definitionally continuousSetPresheaf. This is the existing continuousSetPresheaf_isSheaf theorem, now proved before the bundled continuousSetSheaf is defined.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 4.2.12, p. 30; Lean restriction of Mathlib fpqc descent by J1, 2026-10-23.
